visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Four young women lean over a camera placed on the floor, looking directly down at the lens with neutral to focused expressions. One woman wears a white top, another a black top, and two others have reddish-brown hair. A man's hand enters the frame holding a red card with 'TRE' text. The background is a dark studio ceiling with a red 'TRE' banner visible at the top. (2) The women start jumping rhythmically over the camera. They hold red cards featuring white text and logos towards the lens. The perspective is a low-angle worm's-eye view, capturing their legs and torsos in motion. Their faces show intense concentration and effort as they maintain the synchronized rhythm. (3) The jumping ceases abruptly. The women lean back down towards the camera, smiling broadly and laughing. They point their fingers toward a roll of toilet paper that has appeared in the center of the frame on the floor. The lighting remains bright and consistent throughout the studio environment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male voice speaking in a calm, professional instructional tone in Mandarin, with a moderate pitch and clear articulation. Faint background female murmurs and studio ambient silence are present. (2) A sharp transition occurs as the male speaker counts down '3, 2, 1' with increasing intensity and rising pitch. This is immediately followed by the start of a high-tempo electronic dance track featuring a heavy, synthesized kick drum and bright melodic synth lines. (3) Loud, rhythmic thudding sounds of multiple feet hitting a hard floor surface dominate the mix, perfectly synchronized with the 140 BPM electronic beat. (4) The music cuts out abruptly, replaced by an explosive burst of high-arousal female cheering, yelling, and laughter. The male voice returns with an excited, high-pitched exclamation as the video ends.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a promotional entertainment piece for the TRE event in Tainan. It utilizes a popular 'jumping over the camera' social media trend to create a visually engaging and high-energy sequence. The intent is to grab viewers' attention through rhythmic movement and a comedic 'reveal' at the end (the toilet paper roll), ultimately fostering a fun and approachable brand image for the event.
